text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Mu mbandu, kana nge ke mona muntu mosi ke pasula kitalatala ya kamio, nge lenda tuba nde yandi ke zola kuyiba kamio ya muntu ya nkaka.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Beto fwete tadila yandi mutindu ya nkaka kana yandi vidisaka bansapi ya kamio na yandi mpi kamio yina yandi ke sosa kukota na kati kele kamio na yandi mosi.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI me simbama na mambu ya physique na zina ya Résonance Magnétique Nucléaire (NMR), yina Felix Bloch (vandaka kusala na iniversite ya Stanford) na Edward Purcell (ya iniversite ya Harvard) monaka yo na bamvu 1930.
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Na résonance yayi, champ magnetique mpi onde ya radio ke pusaka ba atomes na kupesa basignales ya fioti ya radio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Na mvu 1970, Raymond Damadian, munganga mpi muntu ya ke salaka bansosa ya siansi, bakisaka kikuma ya kusadila bifwanisu ya résonance magnétique bonso kisadilu sambu na kuzaba maladi ya muntu ke bela.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Mvula iya na nima, bo pesaka diplome mosi, yo vandaka diplome ya ntete ya bo pesaka muntu na mambu ya IRM.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Na 1977, Dr Damadian manisaka kusala scanner ya ntete IRM "ya nitu ya mvimba", yandi pesaka yo zina "ya bo lenda nunga ve".
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Kusolola ya Asynchrone ke siamisaka na kubaka ntangu ya kuyindula mpi ya kuwa bangindu ya bantu ya nkaka.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Yo ke pesaka balongoki nzila ya kusala na vitesi na bo mosi mpi na kuyala bo mosi vitesi yina bo ke longuka mambu.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Diaka, bandilu ya ntangu kele mingi ve sambu nge lenda soba yo mutindu nge me zola. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Kusadila Internet ti Site Internet ya Ntoto ya Mvimba ke sadisaka balongoki na kubaka bansangu konso ntangu.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Balongoki lenda tinda mpi bangiufula na balongi na bo na konso ntangu na kilumbu mpi kuvingila bamvutu mwa nswalu, na kisika ya kuvingila ndenge bo kutana kisika mosi.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Mayele ya bilumbu ke kwisa ke pesa kibeni kimpwanza na mambu yonso. Mitindu ya mbote ya kulonguka kele mingi.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Ya kieleka, mambu ya mbote ya kulonguka kele mingi. Kulonguka ke salamaka na kuwakana na kati ya longoki mpi nzayilu yina bo ke longa yandi.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Mayele na beto ya sesepi ya ke tuba nde sala yo nge mosi mpi bansangu ya bo ke pesa beto, mpi malongi ya me simbamana manaka ya television ke monisa diambu yai.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Bantu mingi kibeni na kati na beto ke talaka manaka ya télévision yina ke songaka beto bametode to mambu yina beto ta salaka ve to yina beto ta sadilaka ve mayele na yo.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Beto ta takangulaka ve kamio sambu na kuyidika yo, beto ta salaka ve fontaine ya masa na kibansala, ta salaka ve nzietelo na Pérou sambu na kutala bisika ya ntama, mpi beto ta yidikaka ve nzo ya voisin na beto.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Matondo sambu na nsinga ya fibre ya opitiki yina Bo me lutisa na insi ya imbu ke vukana na Europe na satelite, bana ya Groenland me kuma na nzila ya kusadila internet na kiteso ya 93%.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Inzo nange ya mvundulu to biyambi nzenza (kana nge vanda na inzo ya banzenza to na nzo ya mvundulu ya bamvwama) ke fwama vanda na wifi to ordinatele ina ke na interneti na bifulu yonso ke na inzo ya internet cafe to bifuku ya nkaka ya bantu yonso kisika wifi kele.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Mutindu yo me talana, ngogo "Eskimo" me kundimama na insi ya America, yo kele ngogo yina bantu mingi ke zingaka ve na Artic ke kuzolaka yo ve, mutindu na Canada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Ata nge lenda wa bankwa-bwala ya Groenland ke sadila ngogo yina bo mosi, banzenza fwete sadila yo ve.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Bantu ina butukaka na Groenland ke kubingaka bo mosi ba Inuit na Canada mpi Kaaalleq (kana mingi Kalaalliti), Greenlander, na Greenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Mambi, ti ntima mbi na kusadisa banzenza kele kima Groenland ke salaka ve. Ata na bambanza nene "bisika ya mpasi" yo kele ve.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Nsungi ya madidi lenda vanda kigonsa mosi kaka ya ngolo bantu ina kuyilamaka ve ta kutana na yo.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Kana beno me kwenda kutala Groenland na ntangu ya madidi (zaba nde na ntangu beno kekwenda mingi mingi na nord, madidi mpi kele ngolo), yo kele mfunu na kuvwata bilele ke lunda tiya.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Bilumbu ya inda ya mwiniyo lenda kubasisa makambu na kubaka ntangu kulunga ya mpongi ti mpasi na nitu.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Na ntangu ya mwini ya ngolo, beno sala keba na bambembele ya norde. Ata bo pesaka kubela ve, bo lenda kufwemisa nitu ngoloi.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Na ntangu nzangululu ya San Francisco ke ya kuvikana na mutindu yo kele kisika ya kitoko ya nsi-ntoto ke bendaka bibumini bisika ya nzenza, nzangululu na yo kele ya mutindu mingi.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Bisika ya kisalu me luta nene ya mfunu kele bisalu ya nene,luyalu, bambongo, kuteka na kusumba ti tourisme.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Ntinula ya yandi ya ntangu a mbidi na ngimbudulu, sindima, nsonokono mpi kintama ya kuzabakana sadisaka na Kutunga ya mbanza mpi bifulu ya mbote kwisa kuzabakana na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco kumatisaka kisalu mosi ya nene ya bantu ya ke salaka nzietelo na nzila ya hôtel ya mingi, ba restaurant ti banzo ya congrès ya ndonga ya ntete.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco kele diaka mosi ya bisika ya mbote mingi ya bwala sambu na madia ya nkaka ya Azia: Korea,Thaï, Inde mpi Japon.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Kusala nzietelo na Walt Disney World yo kele nzietelo ya nene sambu na mabuta ya mingi ya bantu ya Amerika.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Viziti ya "kingenga" ke lombaka kukwenda na avion na aeroport ya bansi mingi ya Orlando, kukwenda na bisi na hotel Disney, kulutisa kiteso ya mposo mosi kukonda kubikisa Disney, mpi kuvutuka kisika nge katukaka.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Bansoba kele mingi kibeni, kansi yai kima ya bantu mingi ke tubilaka ntangu bo ke tubilaka "Kukwenda na Mbanza ya Disney".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Batiket mingi ya bo tekaka na nzila ya interneti na nzila ya sites interneti bonso eBay to Craigslist bo ke sadilaka batike ya kusadila mbala mingi.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Ata yo ke salamaka na kisalu, yo ke pekisamaka na Disney: babiye yo kele ya kupesama na muntu nkaka ve.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Nganda yonso na nsi ya lweke ya Grand Canyon ke lomba nswa ya bamfumu ya bwala ntama kuna.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Mikanda ya nswa ke fioti sambu na kutanina mvwila nene, mpi yoke kumonanaka na kilumbu ya ntete ya ngonda, ngonda iya na ntwala ya ngonda kuyantika.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Yo yina, nswa ya bwala ya ntama na badati ke yantika na dati ya ke vanda na mai ke monanaka na dati ya janvier 1.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Bisika ya bifula yina me zabanai mingi, mutindu mpaka ya Bright Angel ke sika mosi na Mpaka ya Phantom, mingi fulukaka na bandombolo kubumbisa kisika na kilumbu ya ntete.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Ntalu ya bamaswa ke pesa nzila na kutambula kele fioti, nge fwana vanda ya ntete sambu nge kuzwa yo.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Kukota na Afrika ya sudi na kamio ke nzila ya mbote ya kutadila kitoko ya bwala mpi ku kuma na bifulu yina ke na nzila ya bazieti ve.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Yai lenda salama na vetile ya mbote kana yo me yilama mbote mbote, kansi 4x4 kele mfunu kuluta mpi sambu kukuma na bisika mingi 4x4 ke na mfunu sambu na pinei ya zulu.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Beno tula na yitu yina beno ke zonza Afrika ya sude kele na ngemba, yo kele ve mutindu mosi na ba ba insi yina ya bampangi me kuzungidila yandi.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Yina ya me lombama sambu na visa mpi ntalu na yo ke kuswaswana nsi na insi mpi ke tala mingi wapi insi nge me katuka.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Konso bwala kele na nsiku ya kutuba nde voiture yonso fwete vanda na bartkele na kati.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls kele bwala kimfumu ya kitini ya Weste ya Zimbabwe, na ngambu ya nkaka ya Livingstone, na Zambie, ti pene-pene ya Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Bwala ke na kisika na yo na nima ya bifulu ya mabulu, mpi yo kele bima ya ke bendaka bantu mingi, kansi kisika yayi ya bantu ke zolaka kukwenda kutala ke vandaka ya mbote sambu na bantu ya ke sosaka kiese mpi mabaku ya kulutisa ntangu mingi.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Na nsungi ya mvula (ngonda yaNovemba ti ya Malasi), ndilu ya masa ata mata na zulu mpi Falls ke vandaka makelele ngolo mingi.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Ya me kutezwa kana nge me sabuka kimvu nge ke bola to kana nge tambula na nzili ya fioti ke nataka pene-pene masa ke buaka ngolo.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Na kisika ya nkaka, sambu na kiteso ya masa kele mingi ntalulu ya nge ya Falls na ngolo ke vanda mbote ve--yo kekangama na asa yonso.
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Maziamu ya Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 lenda vanda yina me zabakana mingi kati na maziamu ke na ntwala masa to Vallée, kidimbu ya kusonga yina Howard Carter talaka na 1922 na kisika ya maziamu ya Kimfumu ya ntotila yina ya leke.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Kansi na kufwanisa na maziamu ya nkaka ya kimfumu, ndiamu ina ya Toutankhamon ke kaka mfunu fioti bantu kwenda kutala yo, sambu yo kele fioti mpi bima ya mbote-mbote kele kaka fioti.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Konso muntu ke zola kutala imbi yina Bo me sala na mvumbi na ntangu ina bantu zola kubasisa yo na kibumbi yani ke tala nima mpasi sambu ti kaka ntu na mapeka ke monana.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Bamvwama yina ba zikaka na maziamu ke vandaka diaka ve na kati, sambu ti ba katulaka bo na Bo nataka bo na Musée ya Ngipiti na Caire.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Banzenza yina kele na ntangu kaka ya fioti ke sala mbote na kulutisa ntangu ya bo kisika ya kaka.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 kilometre na sude ya Siem Reap. Nsongi ya ngumba ya inzo ya nzambi yayi tungamaka na nsuka ya basenturi 9, na ntangu ya kuzinga ya Ntinu Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Ntangu ya imbi ya tempelo na mbweno ya Tonle Sap Lake ke pesa ntalulu ya mbote na ngumba.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Kukwenda tala kisika yina lenda kusalama nzila mosi na nzietelo na maswa na kukuma na dizanga nene.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Tekila nge kota na tempelo nge fwana vanda na Passeport ya Angkor, na yina kuzimbana ve kunata passeport ya nge yina ke kwisa na Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yelusaleme kele mbanza kimfumu mpi mbanza ya nene ya Israel, ata mingi kuluta ya bansi mpi Nations Unies ke ndima ve Yelusaleme bonso bwala ya kimfumu ya Israel.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Mbanza ya ntama na Judean Hills kele na kintama ya mbote me katuka na mafunda ya bainvu.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Mbanza kele ya santu sambu na mabundu tatu ya ke zabaka Nzambi kele mosi - ya bayuda, ya baklistu ti ya islami, mpi ke sala bonso kisika ya nene ya kusambila, inzo ya nzambi ti ya culture.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Sambu na mambu ya mabundu ya nzambi ya mbanza, mpi mingi mingi bisika mingi ya kitini ya Mbanza ya ntama, Yelusaleme kele kisika ya ntete wapi bazieti ke kwendaka.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yeruzalemi kele na bifulu mingi ke songaka kintama, busosi bima ya ntama ya yisi ya toto na kinkoko, kubwela bamagaze ya nene mpi ya kufuluka na bantu, banzo ya cafe mpi bifulu bantu ke dyaka.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Equateur ke lomba nde mwana yonso ya insi ya Cuba kuzwa mukanda ya bo ke bingila yandi na ntwala ya kukota na Equateur na nzila ya aeroport to bisika ya kukota na ndilu ya insi.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Mukanda yai fwete kutulwa kiniemo na Ministele ke talaka mambu ya banzenza ya Equateur na kuzitisa ba ndombolo ya luyalu ya bwala.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Mambu ya bo ke lombaka, bo me yidikaka yo na bantu ya bansi zole yina kutambula na ndonga.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Bana ya insi ya Cuba bo kele na carte verte ya Amerika fwete kwenda na consulat ya Equateur sambu na kuzwa nswa ya kubasika na yina bo me lomba bo.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Passeport ya nge fwana kuvanda na mbote bangonda sambanu tekila dati ya nge ya nzietelo. Na ntoto to na avio nge fwana vanda na tike ya nge na kusonga ba ntangu yikwa nge zola zika na bwala to insi.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Banzietelo kele na ntalu ya kukuluka na yina me tadila bikunku mingi, na yina kana nge kele nge mosi to na nduku mosi kaka, meka ku bumina bantu ya nkaka na beno ku yidika kikunku ya bantu iya ti sambanu sambu ntalu vanda ya ku kuluka na konso muntu.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Diambu yayi lenda kutala beno ve, sambu ti mingi ya Bibumini bisika ke lutisaka ntangu mingi tekila bo zwa bakamio.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Yo monanaka bonso kele kima ya mbote ya kukusa bantu kusonga bo nde bofwete futa mingi.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Kuluta kutombuka na zulu kuna na nsuka ya norde ya Machu Picchu, kele ngumba ya ndelo, mingi-mingi yo ke vandaka bisika ya bafoto ya mbanza ya kufwa.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Yo ke pesa kikesa ve na kutala mambu ya ke na insi, yo kele mpasi mpi na kumata, kansi bantu ya ke lunga mbote na mayele fwete lunga kumanisa yo na miniti 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Bisika ya kutambula na zulu ya matadi yo tulamaka na kitini mosi ya nene ya nzila mpi na bisika ya kukita, bakable ya mabende yo ke pesaka maboko ya lusadisu.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Disongidila, yindula kuvanda na mupepe na kivumunu ve na bumba nitu yange ka kukuma ntama ve, sungula na kati ya masa, kuna ya ke kuma imbi mingi.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Kele ti dibulu ya fioti na zulu yina nge fwete lutila; yo kele kibeni na nsi mpi ya kukangama ngolo.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Kumona kisika mpi banmbisi ya Galapagos me salama mbote na bwatu, kaka mpila yina Charles Darwin salaka na 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Kuluta bamaswa 60 vandada sabuka masa ya Galapagos na mulonga na bantu ya ke sala nzietelo 8 tii na 100.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Bantu mingi ke kubikaka kisika na bo ya kuvandila mbote mbote (sambu bantu mingi ke vandaka na nzietelo ya maswa na nsungi ya inda).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Beno zaba mbote agent nge ke sumbila tiki kele muntu me zaba mbote-mbote Galapagos yandi fete kuzaba maswa ya mpila na mpila.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Yo tasala nde difuti na nge ti / to kupesa mpasi na yayi ke lunga mbote na bwatu ya mbote sambu na bo.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Na ntwala bantu ya Espagne kumaka na Senturi 16, Chilie ya norde vandaka na luyalu ya Inca na bantu ya mfinda ya Araucaniens (Mapuche) vandaka zinga na kati-kati ya Chilie na sude.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Bamapuche kuvandaka mpi mosi ya bimvuka ya nsuka bankwa ntoto ya Amedika ya kimpwanza, bayayi kuvandaka na domination ya hispanophone kaka na nima ya kimpwanza ya Chili.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Ata insi ya Chilie zwaka kimpwanza na 1810 (na nima ya bamvita ya Napoleon nwanaka yina katulaka luyalu ya Espagne ya kati-kati bamvula zole), nungunu na ntwala ya Espagne manisaka ve tii na 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Insi ya Saint Domingue kele insi ina kele na Caraibe ina ke ya kuyalangana tii na kibuku ya ndambu ya este ya ntoto ya Espagne, wapi ntoto ke kabwanaka na Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Katula makumu ya djelo ya mpembe mpi bambonokono ya ngumba, insi kele kisika ya kuzinga ya mbanza ya ntama ntama ya Europa na Amerika, bubu yayi mosi ya Distrike ya Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Ba Tainos mpi Ba Caribe vandaka bantu ya ntete ya kuzinga na kisanga yango. Ba caribe kuvandaka bantu ya ke tuba Arawakan yai ya kumaka mfinama na mvu 10,000 na Ntwala ya ya Lubutuku ya Klisto.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Na nima ya bamvula fioti ya kukuma ya bifimpi bwala ya bantu ya europa, bantu ya Tainos kulukaka mingi na ntalu na basodani yuinsi ya Espagne.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Na kutalaka Fray Bartolomé ya Las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) na 1492 ti 1498, bantu ya Espani kuvandaka Bataínos kuluta 100 000.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión kele kisika yina tungamaka mutindu inzo ya bisadi ya Nzambi ya bakento, na nganda ya inzo ya ntinu na Senturi 17, kati na yo kele Tempelo ya San Diego ntunga yina mosi kaka bikisamaka.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Yo kele salama sesepi bonso kisika ya plaza ya kati, mpi mbala mingi yoke na bima mingi ke kusalama, mpimpa ti mwini.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Banzo ya kudila kele ya mingi fioti na distrike ya jardin, mpi na nima ya midi mpi na bankokila bo ke bulaka concert ya ofele na gaebo ya katikati.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Na mwa mbongo ya fioti bana ta tela nge disolo.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Kimvuka ya bantu ya bwala yina kibeni ke vandaka na Howe Sound kaka na mupanzi ya Vancouver, mpi bo ke kumaka kuna na nzila ya taxi ya masa yina ya bo manaka me zabana kukatuka na kisanga ya Grandville na ville ya Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Na ba yina ke yangalalaka na bisalu ya nganda, kuzieta na nsamba ya Mbu na Yulu kele mfunu ngolo.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (nawola mosi ti ndambu ya kutambula na Vancouver) yo kele ntalu kansi yo me zabana sambu na nsaka ya Olympiques ya hiver ya 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Na ntangu ya madidi, nge fwana kusielumuka na zulu ya matadi ya madidi na America ya Norde, mpi na ntangu ya mwini ya ngolo meka ku tambula na velo na ngumba.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Mukanda ya nswa fwete bumbama na ntwala. Nge fwete vanda na mukanda ya nswa sambu na kulala mpimpa mosi na Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena kele mosi ya bisika ya sinzidi ya ke pesaka bisika ya kulala mpi madia ya tiya na zulu ya bisika ya Camp. La Leona, San Pedrillo, mpi Los Patos ke pesaka kaka bisika ya camp kukonda madia.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Muntu lenda kusumba banswa ya parke kuna kaka na kisika ya Ranger na Puerto Jimenez, kansi bo ndimaka mfutulu na bikalati ve.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Bisalu ya Park (MINAE) ke pesaka nswa ya park ve ngonda mosi kuluta na ntwala ya kukuma.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Bisanga ya Cook kele kisanga ya insi na kuwakana ya mpamba na kimvuka na Nouvelle Zelande, yai ya kele na Polynesie, na katikati ya Mbu ya Pacifique du Sud.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Yo kele kimvuka ya bisanga 15 ya insi ya kati ya masa ya ke kuyalangana na ba milio 2.2 ya ba km2 ya osean.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Kuvandaka na fuseau horaire mosi yai ti Hawaï, bisanga ke monanaka mbala nkaka bonso "Hawaï na insi".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Ata yo kuvanda fioti kuluta, yo ke yibuka ndambu ya bambuta mingi ya kwisaka kutala Hawii na ntwala yo kukuma insi ya luyalu nkatu ba hotel ya minene mpi ntombwama ya nkaka.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Bisanga ya Cook yo ke vandaka ti mbanza ve kansi yo kele ti bisanga 15 ya kuswaswana. Ya mfunu kele Rarotonga ti Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Bubu, na babwala ya insi ya bamvwama, kupesa bisika ya kudia nsuka na kulala me kuma mpilamosi na kisalu ya ntoko.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Na zulu na yonso, B&Bs ke nwanina na bima zole ya mfunu kuluta: Kulala mpi Kudia na suka suka.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Yo yina, na bisika ya kitoko ya mutindu yai, nge lenda kuta badrap ya ntalu mingi, mbala ya nkaka drap ya bo me sala na maboko to drap ya insi ntama .
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Madia ya suka lenda vanda ti bima ya kitoko ya nsungi ya kisika yina to madia yina munkwa-nzo ke zolaka.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Kisika lenda vanda nzo ya nene ya ntama na bisadilu ya ntama, ntoto ya bunkete na kizinga ya kuyobidila.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Kukota na voiture na nge mosi mpi kukwenda na vwayaje ya ntama kele mbote.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Mutindu bakamio ya nene, nge fwete zaba mbote-mbote kunata kamio ya nge na zaba mpi bandilu na yo.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kutedimisa nzo ya lele na lupangu ya muntu to na kati ya mbanza ya konso kuyalangana lenda kupenda meso ya bantu.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Na bunkufi, kusadila kamio na nge kele dibanza ya mbote kuluta sambu na nzietelo kansi yo kele mpasi yo kuvanda na yo mosi mpila ya ku "campe".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kutambula na kamio kele mbote kana beno kele na fourgonette, SUV, mosi ya berline to break ti bakiti ya kutandama.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Ba hotele ya nkaka kele na difwafwa ya ntangu ya wolo yamasini ya muku ya nlai na maswa ya nene ya nzila ya masa ya mungwa yo bantikaka na siekele 19 to na mbatukulu ya siekele 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: banzo yayi ya mvundulu ya ba mvwama mpi bantu ya kuzabakana vandaka na vandaka kudya mbote mpi kulutisa ba pimpa ya mbote.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Ndwatulu ya ntama ya mbote, konda kubaka bima yampa, mpi mpila ya kununa ya mbote kele mpi ndambu ya bifu na Bo.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Peleko bo kele mvwilu ya Bot mosis-mosi, bo ke ku talaka mbote na ku bumina bamfumu ya bwala na ba ntumwa ya bwala.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Muntu ya ke sala nzietelo yina ke na kiteso ya mbongo mingi lenda zieta na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, na lenda zinga na banzo ya mvundulu ya bamvwama.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Rezo ya kuyamba banzenza, kele kikunku yina ke vukisaka bantu ya ke sala nzietelo na bantu ya bwala yina kele kisika bo ke kumina.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kukota na rezo ya mpila yayi, mingi-mingi kelombaka kusonika na mukanda na internete; Ata barezo ya nkaka ke lombaka nde bo tala mambu na nge ntete mbote mbote.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Mazina ya biyambi ya banzenza ke tulwaka na mikanda mpi na internet, bantangu ya nkaka na ba adelesi ya bo na ke tangwaka na bantu ya ke sala nzietelo ya nkaka.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing kusalamaka na ngonda ya Yanuari 2004 na nima ya programmeur mosi ya informatique Casey Fenton kuzw avion mosi na ntalu ya mbote sambu na kukwenda na Icelande kansi yandi vandaka na kisika ya kubikala ve.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Yandi sonikilaka balongoki ya universite ya malongi ya inda ya bwala, na yandi kutambulaka na nima, mikanda mingi ina vandaka kusonga bifulu mingi ya kuladila konda kufuta mbongo ina bantu kubikilaka yandi.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: banzo ya mvundulu me salama ntete sambu na bantuenia-Kizingi ya kisika yina ke na bamvula makumi tatu - kansi nge lenda mpi kutala na kati bantu ya ke sala nzietelo ya bamvula mingi.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Bibuti ya kele ti bana ke monanaka mingi ve, kansi bisika ya nkaka ya banzo ke pesaka bo nzila na masuku sambu na bo mosi.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Mbanza ya Pékin na Chine yo ta vanda mbanza mosi ya lukumu ya bansaka ya Jeux Olympiques ya hiver ya 2022, yai ta sala yo mbanza mosi ya ntete ya kuyamba bansaka ya Jeux Olympiques ya ntangu ya Mwini mpi ya Madidi.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing tayamba kukangula ya bansaka ti kukanga ya milulu na nsaka ya glace na kibanzala ya kati ya inzo.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Bansaka ya nkaka ya ski ta salama na kisika ya ski ya Taizicheng na Zhangjiakou, yina kele kiteso ya bakilometre 220 (140 miles) katuka na Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Batempelo mingi kuluta kele na kilumbu ya kuyangalala na mvula kubanda na nsuka ya ngonda ya Novemba tii na Katikati ya ngonda ya Mai ya ke sobana na kutala manaka ya tempelo mosi mosi.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Bankinsi mingi ya tempelo ke salamaka na mpila ya aniversere ya tempelo to ya aniversere ya nzambi yai ya ke twadisaka to ya nkinsi ya nkaka ya nene me kangama na tempelo.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Bankinzi ya tempelo ya Kerala ke vandaka kiese mingi na kutala, yo ke vandaka na kutambula ya banzoku yai bo me bongisa mbote-mbote, bantu ya ke mbilaka na tempelo, mpi bankinzi ya nkaka.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Manaka ya kutadisa bima na meso ya bantu yonso (me zabana na zina ya Exposition Mondiale to Expo) ke mukembo ya ba insi yonso na kusonga bizizi mpi kuzaba ya konso kima.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Babwala kesalaka baexposition ya artistique ti ya kubokula na kati ya bapavillons nationaux sambu na kusonga makambu ya mokili to ya culture ti ya histoire ya bwala na bo.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Manaka ya nene ya nsi-ntoto ya kukuna bifulu sala mukembo kuma mbote na bulakisi bifuani ya bifulu, ntoto ya bifulu mpi konso kima yima me tala bifulu.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Na kuwakana ba lenda kuzua kisika konso mvula (kaka na ntangu yina ba kezingaka ya ba insi ya luswaswanu), na bansadilu bo ke salaka ve.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Makambu yayi kusalaka bangonda tatu ti sambanu mpi yosalamaka na bisika ya 50 hectares.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Kele na mitindu mingi ya cinema yai ya bo ke sadilaka mvula na mvula. Film ya standard ya 35 mm (negatif ya 36 na 24 mm) ke yina ya ke monana na bantu yonso.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Yo lenda pesama na mutindu ya kulunga na pete kana yo me konda nge ; mpi kupesa nzila ya kuyidika mfinama na kumeka na DSLR ya sesepi.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Kisadilu kikangi bizizi lenda kubasisa bizizi ya yinda mingi ve ke sadilaka format ya 6 na 6 cm na ludelede 56 na 56 mm ya bukento.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Yo ke pesaka nene yina me luta mbala iya nene ya negatif ya 35 mm (3136 mm2 contre 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Bambisi ya mfinda ke na kati ya bima ke vandaka bizizi ya mpasi samuna kubaka na kibaki ya bizizi, buna yo ke sosaka kibaki ya bizizi fwana kuvanda na buesso, luvibudulu, mvula mingi na kisalu na bisadilu ya mbote.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Bizizi na mfinda me bakamaka nkina kima ya mpai ve, kansi kubaka bizizi zola kusonga ti kizizi kele na kimvwama ya difunda mosi ya ngogo.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Kukanga foto ya bambisi ya zamba mbala mingi ke lombaka matala-tala ya kutadila na ntama Ata bima bonso bizizi ya kimvuka ya bandeke to kivangwa ya fioti mingi-mingi ke kulombaka kisalulu ya matala-tala ya mutindu ya nkaka.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Bambisi mingi ya nzenza ke vandaka mpasi na kumona, mpi baparke mbala mingi ke vandaka na bansiku ina me tala kubaka bafoto sambu na kutekisa yo.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Bambisi ya mfinda lenda vanda nsoni-nsoni to ngansi-ngansi. Kisika bo ke zingaka lenda vanda madidi, tiya, to imbi kibeni.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Bandinga 5000 kele na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, kubwela kulutila binzonzi ndinga makumi zole ti makumi tanu ya ba milio.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Ba ngogo yina Bo me kusonika ke vandaka mpasi ve na kubakula yo. Ya kele mpasi na kutanga mazina ya bifulu ya nkaka ya kuvandila.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Bantu ya bansi mingi ya mvimba ke tubaka Angele mbote, mpi na kuluta mingi nge lenda kumona bayina ya kuzaba fioti mingi mingi na kati ya baleke.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Yindula nde, kana nge vanda, na muntu ya Mancunia, Bostonia, Jamaica mpi ya ngambu ya Sidney kuvanda na nziunga ya mesa kudia na nkokila na restaurant mosi ya Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Bo ke yangalalaka na kutubaka binsamu ya bwala, yina bantu ya Distrike ya bo ke tubaka na mutindu ya kuzonzila mpi na ndinga ya bwala ya bo mosi.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kusumba madia na ba supermarchés kele mbala mingi nzila ya kusumba na ntalu ya fioti sambu na kudia. Na kukonda mambote ya kikuku, kusola kele na limite na madia ya kikuku.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Mbala na mbala, ba supermarché ke pesaka bima mpila na mpila ya madia ya kikuku. Bankaka kepesaka ata four ya micro-ondes to bampila ya nkaka ya kuyamuna madia.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Na ba insi ya nkaka to na mutindu ya magasin ya nkaka, kele na restaurant mosi ya kisika yina, mbala mingi ya kuzabana na leta ve na bantalu ya mbote.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Tala zaba kusala mpi kunata bakopi ya bansiku mpi banimelo mpi addresi assureur na nge ti nge.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Bo fwana kusonga kisonokono na zina ya "email" mpi singa ya alo alo ya inzo ya kifuti bantu kana mambu ya mpasi me kukumina bo, sambu na malongi/bamuswa mpi kusala bandombolo.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Bumba mukanda ya nkaka na nkutu ya nge na na internet (kusonika mukanda na nge mosi na ku bwela mukanda to kubumba na "cloud").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Kana nge me kwenda mobembo ti ordinateur portable to tablette, bumba kopie mosi na kati ya memoire nayo to na disk (ya kukota kana Internet kele ve).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Pesa mpi diaka bakopi ya politiki / ya banimelo na banduku ya voyage ti na babuti to na banduku ya bwala yayi kele na luzolo ya kusadisa beno.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Mbisi me kuzabana na zina ya orignal (kibulu ya mampoka) kele na miangu mingi ve kansi kana yandi me kunwanuswa yandi ke kunwana mpe.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Ntangu bantu ke mona ve kigonsa ya mbambi, bo lenda kupusana penepene mpi kuditula bo mosi na kigonsa.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Beno nwa malafu ya kulawuka malembe. Alcool ke salaka na nitu ya bantu yonso mpila mosi ve mpi yo kele mfunu mingi na kuzaba ndilu na nge.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Kuvanda na mavimpi ya mbote ntangu ya yinda na nwinu Malafu ke bebisaka nitu mpi ke fwaka misu na kenataka mpi na lufwa. Mambu ya mpasi ke kumaka ngolo kana nge ke na kunwa Malafu ya ngolo.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Malafu yina luyalu yiminaka lenda kuvanda na bima ya mbi yina lenda bebisa nitu ya muntu bake bingaka metanole, yo lenda kufwa meso to kunata na lufwa ata na kunwa ya ba doze fyoti fyoti.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Bineti lendaa vanda ntalu na insi ya nzenza, mingi na ba insi ya kimvwama ya fioti kisitu difuta na kisalu kele fioti.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Beno kanina kusala ezame ya meso na nzo, mingi mingi kana yokele na kati ya assurance, mpi beno nata ordonance ya kupesa kisika ya nkaka.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Bisika ya bima ya ntalu mingi yai kele na ba région lenda vanda na mambu zole; ya nkaka lenda vanda kusadila na mpila ya mbote ve, ti bima ya nakka ya bwala banzena lenda vanda ntalu mingi kuluta na bwala na beto.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kafe kele mosi na bima ke tekamaka mingi na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, na nge lenda kuzua ya mutindu na mutindu na bwala ya nge.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Kansi, mutindu ya kunwa café kele kuswanikisa na ntoto ya mvimba yo kele mfunu ya kumeka.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: bo ke na zulu ya Proxy Web na mambu mingi: bo ke nataka ba nsonokono ya internet yonso, kaka http ve.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Na kulanda nsiku bo ke pesaka nsinga ya interneti ya ntinu kuluta mpi kusala kisalu ya mbote. Bo ke ya kutula yo na bidimbu ya ntalu mpi mutindu ina mpasi na kusosa kuzaba mambu na yo.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Bakompani ya kupanza nsangu ke tuba luvunu na yina me tala kikuma ya mambu yai, kutubaka nde yo kele sambu kubuya bantu "kukota na sekele ya bantu".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Bacode ya Distrike kele na ngolo ve na kukanga ba copie luyalu me yimina, copie ya ndambu ndambu ya disque lenda me ku zonza mbote kulutila original ya disque.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Mfunu ya ntangu yai kele kupesa kompani luyalu na zulu ya bazandu na boyonso ya ke teka; yonso kele sambu mbongo kutambula.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Sambu bo ke nataka bansangu na nzila ya Internet, mfunu kele ve ya kusadila kompani ya telefone ina kele na kisika ya ke zingaka to ya nge ke sala nzietelo.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: kele mpi na kima ya kufwete sala ete nge kuzwa nimelo katuka na kimvuka ya bantu wapi nge ke zinga; nge lenda kuzwa connexion ya interneti na nzila ya satellite na mutindu ya Chicken, Alaska mpi kupona nimelo ya ke songa nde nge ke na insi ya ntangu ya Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Mbala mingi, nge fwete sumba nimero ya insi ya mvimba ya kukabwana yai ta pesa batelefone PSTN nswa ya kubinga nge. Kisika nimero me tuka ke vandaka mfunu mingi sambu na bantu yina ke binga.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Kisadula ya kubalula bandinga-bisadilu ina lenda kubalula mambu na ndinga ya nkaka yo mosi lenda kubalula kikunku ya bisono na ndiga mosi tii na ndinga ya nkaka.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Ba application ya nkaka ya mpila yai lenda kutu bongola mukanda na bandinga ya banzenza na zulu ya bidimbu to bima ya nkaka na kati ntoto ya mvimba na ntangu muntu kesadila me pona smartphone na bima yai.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Kisadilu ya ku balula bansonoko na ndinga ya nkaka kumaka mbote mingi na yo salaka ti bubaludi bansonoko na ndinga nkaka vanda mbote (na bansonoko ya mbi), kansi kusala angele fwana kuvanda sambu ba ntangu ya nkaka yo ke pesaka bansonokono ya mbi.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Mosi ya bisadilu ya mbote mingi ya mpila yayi kele Google Translate, yo kepesaka nzila na kubalula ndinga kukonda interneti na nima ya kubaka na internet bima ya mambu ya ndinga yina ya nge zola kubalula.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Kusadila application ya GPS sambu na kusonga nzila na telefone na yo lenda vanda nzila ya pete mpi ya kulunga kuluta sambu na kutambula ntangu nge kele na nganda ya insi na nge.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Yo lenda kubumba mbongona kisika ya kusumba carte ya mpa sambu na GPS mosi, to appareil ya GPS ya standard to kudefa mosi ya kompani ya kamio ya ke defisaka.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Kana nge kele ve na unite sambu na telefone na nge, to ntangu yo kele ntama na diboko, kusala na yo lenda kukonda to yo lenda monana ve.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Ba songi yonso kele ya kufuluka na ba kalate ya nsinga yina ba lenda sadila na nsinga ya komelese to na ba singa ya mpamba.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Kana bakalati mingi yokepesaka nzila na kubinga ata nki kisika, ya nkaka yokele sambu na kupesa bantalu ya kubinga mfunu na bimvuka ya babwala.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Na ku kota na baselevice yayi nge fwana binga nsinga alo alo konda mbongo.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Misiku me tadila ku baka bizizi ke talaka mpi mutindu ya kubumba bizizi, mpi mambu mingi ya nkaka.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Kana muswa me pesama na kuzwa bizizi, nge lenda ata kuyindula ve ku bumba bizizi ya bo.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Kana beno kele kusadila drone, beno tala mbote kana beno mepesama nswa na ntwala ya kufilme mpi nki mukanda to lisanse yayi kele mbote.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kupumbusa drone mfinama na nganda ya avion to na zulu ya kimvuka ya bantu mingi kele ntangu yonso libanza ya mbi, ata ke na yo me pesama nswa na distrike na nge.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Na kilumbu ya bubu sambu na kusala nzietelo na mupepe bantu ke na ku futa tike ve kana bo me kusosa ntete ve mpi kuswasikisa ba ntalu ya kufuta.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Ntangu ya nkaka avion kaka mosi yina lenda vanda na ntalu ya kuswaswana mpi bo ke futaka sambu na kumeka resultats mpi kutala na website ya avion yina mosi na ntwala ya kusala reservation.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Ntangu nge lenda ndima ve viza sambu na visite ya ntangu fioti na bansi ya nkaka bonso touriste to sambu na affaires, kukwenda kuna boso nlongoki ya insi ya nzenza ke lomba kubikala ntangu mingi kuluta visite ya mbala mosi bonso touriste.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Mingi mingi kuvanda na bwala ya nzenza ntangu ya nda yoke lombaka nge vanda ti viza.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Baviza ya bana ya nzo-nkanda mingi-mingi ke vandaka ti mambu ya kuswaswana ya bo ke lombaka mpi mutindu ya kuswaswana ya kulomba yo, na kutadila baviza ya bantu ke kwisa kutala bwala to ya mumbongo.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Na ba insi mingi, nge fuana kuzua mukanda ya universite ina nge zola kulonguka na mukanda ke kusonga kana nge ke na mbongo ya kulunga na kufuka mvula ya ntete ya universite nge mosi.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Zikisa mambu mbote-mbote na bimvuka ya luyalu, mpi depatema ya Immigration sambu na insi wapi nge ke zola kulonguka na kubaka bansangu ya mingi kuluta.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Katula kaka kana nge kele ntumwa ya insi ya nkaka, to nge ke salaka na bwala ya nzenza yo ke zola tuba mingi mingi nde nge fwete lomba mpaku ya difuta na bwala ya nge ke vandaka.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Mpaku ya bo ke bakaka na salere me swaswana na bansi ya kuswaswana, mpi ntalu ya mpaku mpi mutindu ya kuzenga yo me swaswana mingi na kutadila konso insi.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Na nayinzi kele mvukani ya ba mbanza mingi mutindu Amerika na Canada, mpaku na mbongo yina muntu ke zwaka ke katukaka bisika zole na na kisika mbula matadi na bamfumu ya bwala, na kiteso mpi mbongo yina me ku tezwa kele ya luswaswanu na ba mbanza.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Na ntangu ina Bansosa ya ku zieta na insi ya nzenza kele mingi ve to kufulusa mikanda na kukota ya nge na bwala, Bansosa ya Birokoti mbongo lenda kupesa beno itu pasi.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Tala mbote nde nge zaba inki nge lenda sala/tuba to lrndave kutuba/kusala na kutuba bima ya kuluta banswa ya nsiku me pesa nge.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Nzila ya kuluta pete ya kuyantika kisalu ya kusonika mambu ya nzietelo kele kuvanda ti mayele ya kusonika blog ya ke tubila nzietelo.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Kana nge me kuma ti kusala formattage mpi kusala site internet, na nima, nge lenda sala site internet na nge mosi.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Kusala kisalu ya luzolo ya mbote ntangu nge ke sala nzietelo kele mutindu ya nene ya kusala luswaswanu kansi yo kele ve kaka kupesa.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Kuzinga na kusala kisalu konda kuzwa difuti na insi ya nzenza ke nzila ya mbote na ku bakula kintama ya luswaswanu, kuvukana na bantu, kuzaba bo, kuvanda na mpive kwenda na mantuala na ku bwela mpi ba nsadilu ya nkaka.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Yotalenda mpi vanda mpila mosi ya mbote ya kusala budget yo vanda nene sambu na kupesa nzila na kuvanda bilumbu mingi, sambu bisalu mingi ya mpamba yokepesaka bisika ya kuvanda ti pension ti bankaka kefutaka mwa mbongo ya nsuka ya ngonda.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: basoda ya insi ya Scandinave sadilaka nzila ya masa ya batu ya Russie na kukuma na Imbu ya Ndombe na Imbu ya Caspienne. Bisika ya nkaka ya nzila yayi lenda mpi kusadulwa ti bubu yayi. Nge fuana sosa mukanda ya kingenga ya kulutila yo kele mpasi na kuzua.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Mubu ya Mpembe--Nzila ya Baltiki me kuvukisa Oseani ya Arctiki na Oseani ya Baltiki na nzila ya Dizanga Nene ya Onega, Dizanga Nene ya Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, mingi na banzadi mpi masanga nene.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Kuikila yo kana nge me simba maswa ya marinas mambu yonso ke vanda ya kuzabakana. Nge ke vukana bantu ke bwilaka maswa na bo ke kabula bansangu na nge.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Na bunkufi, nge ta tula bansangu ya ke monisa nde nge ke zola kusadisa, nge ta kwenda kutambula na dibungu, ta pusana pene-pene ya bantu ina ke yobisa maswa na bo, mpi ta sosa kusolula ti bantu ya ke salaka na maswa na bare, mpi buna na buna.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Meka kutuba na bantu mingi yayi nge lenda. Na nima ya mwa ntangu, bantu yonso t azaba nge mpi bo ta songa nge nki bantu nge fwete baka.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Nge fwete kusola mukanda ya bansangu ya nzietelo ya avio nabuku ya bansangu malembe.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Nge lenda tala ti ya kele mutindu kima ya kusakana to ya mbamya ya kukota kompani ya avio yina nge ke zieta na yo, zaba ti nzila yina me kupesama na nge kele ya luswaswanu na nzietelo lenda vanda mbote na na kompani ya luswaswanu na kintwadi mosi.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Bakompani ya Avion bonso Emirates, Ethiad Airways, Qatar Airways mpi Turkish Airways me panza bisalu na bo mingi na Afrika, mpi ke na baBiro ya kukwenda na site mingi ya nene ya Afrika na ntalu mosi ya mfunu kuluta kompani ya nkaka ya Europa/Mputu.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines kezetaka na babwala 39 na insi 30 ya Afrika kubanda 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Kana nge kele ti ntangu ya kusala diaka nzietelo, tala mbote sambu na kuzaba ntalu ya mbongo ya nge ta futa na Afrika kana nge fwanisa yo ti ntalu ya mbongo ya ntoto ya mvimba.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Vila ve na kuyika ntalu ya ta yikama na visa ya nkaka, mpaku ya kukwenda, transport, mpi ya nkaka nkaka sambu na bisika yina yonso na nganda ya Afrika ya Sudi.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Ya ke na kompani ve ya avio ke kumaka tii na mubu ya nene ya Hemisphere ya sudi (na SkyTeam ke kumaka ve na bisika yayi).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Na yina, Star Alliance ke yalaka bima yonso katula Pacifique ya Banda ya esete na Santiago ya Chilie tii na Tahiti, bame binga avio ya LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Bo me sonikaka bazina na bo na mukanda ya bantu me yinga bima ya insi ya mvimba na UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Na nima ya nkama ya bamvula, bantu me kuyidika na ngemba yonso bisika ya kuvwandila mpi kupemisa nitu ya kutalana na meso ya bantu na me tadisa na mabundu ne ke pesa pumpala yonso ya mabundu.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Mosi ya mbote na yandi kele kukonda kompani ya ke zabana polele. Banzila, batrain mpi na bamaswa ke tambulaka na banzila na babwala, bavoiture yo lenda kuzwa bo ve na nganda.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Bifwani ya Fwalansa ke tubamaka na Belgique na Suisse kele ya kuswaswana na yina ba ke tubaka ba Fwalansa ya insi ya Falanse, peleko yo kele ya kudedakana na kusolwa.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Yoyina, système ya numérotation na Belgique francophone ti na Suisse kepesaka bampila mosi ya pete yayi kesalaka kukesana ya kutuba Français na France, ti prononciation ya bandinga ya nkaka kele ya kukesana mwa fioti.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Na kutala, ba Français yonso ke tubaka ndinga ya ba ya baBelge na ya baSuisse longukaka Français na universite na yina bo ke kuwa nge mbot mbote kana nge ke na kuwakana Français mutindu bo.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Na bifulu mingi ya nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, kunanguka ya masa mutindu ya kinduku ke kusongaka kuwakana "mbote".
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Yo yina, na Malaisie na Bwala ya Bamalezien na bisika na bo ya bwala, ndinga ke songa "kwisa" mpila mosi ti musapi ya zole na nitu, bokesadilaka yo mingi na babwala ya occidental, mpi yo fwete salama sambu na mfunu yina.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Mpila mosi, muntu ya Grande-Bretagne ya ke sala nzietelo na Espagne, yo lenda kuvilana ti vague adieu ya diboko na ntwala (kuluta muntu yayi bo kele kusonga) kidimbu ya kuvutuka.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Bandinga yayi me tulama kele bandinga artificielle to me salama sambu na kusala pete na disolo ya bantu ya nkaka yayi lenda vanda na mpasi ya kotuba.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Yo kele ya kukesana ti lingua francas, yayi kele bandinga ya bantu to yabaorganike yayi kekuma ngolo sambu na mfunu ya nkaka to na mpila bantu ya bandinga ya nkaka ke tubaka yo.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Na kati ya ntangu ya kilumbu, bantu ya banzietelo lenda tala bamirage yai kupesa ngindu ya masa (to makambu ya nkaka).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Yayi lenda vanda kigonsa kana muntu ya ke sala nzietelo ke landa miraje, na kuludisaka ntangu mpi na kubikala na masa.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Ata nsi makanga ya tiya kuluta lenda kuma madidi kuluta na mpimpa. Kufwa na madidi kele kigonsa kibeni na kukonda bilele ya tia.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Na nsungi ya kisiwu, nge ta vanda mingi mingi na mfunu ya kutina mbembele kana me baka lukanu ya kwenda tambula na mfina ya masa-masa.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Ata kana nge ke tambwisa kamio na bamfinda na nsi ya ntangu, kubika baporte ya kukangula mwa basekonde fioti ntangu nge ke kota na kati me fwana sambu bambembele kukota na kati ya kamio ti nge.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Kimbefo ya grippe ya bandeke, lenda kanga bandeke mpi bambisi ina ke nwisaka bana na bo mabele.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Makambu mingi kutadisamaka na bantu, kansi ya nkaka na kati na bo kuvandaka ya kufwa.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Mingi ke tadilaka bantu yina ke salaka ntoto ya tuma, kansi yo kele mpi ti mwa bigonsa sambu na bantu ina ke longukaka bandeke.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Bafjords yayi kutinaka mpi na mabengi yayi kupesaka nzila na plato ya nene ya mpila mosi ya Norvege.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Bifulu mingi ya ntota ke ya kulala ke na zina ya "vidde" yina zola kuwakana kisika banti kele ve, kisika ya nene konda nsukulu.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Na Rogaland na Agder, bo ke bingaka yo "hei", yina zola kuwakana ntoto yina ke na ba iti ve kansi kele ya ba iti fyoti fyoti mingi.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Baglace ke nikana-nikanaka, mpi yo ke kulumukaka na ngumba. Yo ke pusanaka, ke zenganaka, ebuna bapont ya neige lenda kanga yo nzila na kumonana.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Bibaka mpi baludi ya mabulu ya matadi ya madidi lenda kubwa mpi kupasuka lenda kangama.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Na bisika me zungidila matadi ya mpembe, matadi ya nene ya mpembe me pasuka, ke losoka ntama to kuvindumuka na kwenda ntama na matadi.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Ntangu ya mbote bibumini bifulu ya ngumba ke vandaka mingi na ntangu ya mini ya ngolo mpi ya tiya mingi ya insi ya Inde.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Na kutala, bo kele na kitoko ya luswaswanu mpi bumpala na ntangu ya madidi, na bisadula mingi na bangumba ke yambaka matadi kepesaka mavimbi ya mbote na kepesaka nzila na kutambula na matadi mpi kusala bansaka.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Bakompani fioti mpamba ya avion ke vandaka ti batike ya bantalu ya mafwa, yo ke kulumusaka ntalu fioti sambu na nzietelo ya ntinu-ntinu ya mafwa.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Ba avion yina ke pesaka yo kele Air Canada, Delta Airlines, Luthansa na banzietelo ke katuka na Amerika to Canada na Westjet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Na mpila yonso, beno fwete bumba mbala mosi kisika na nzila ya téléfone na kompani ya avion.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
